about: Sample buses and per-golden render inputs for tests/golden/watch (issue #7, revision 2). Generated by docs/design/watch_v2_mock.py; edit there and regenerate. Times are UTC and the goldens are rendered with TZ=UTC, colour off. A paused entry renders its `held` snapshot as of view.frozen.t_now and counts +N new from `snapshot`. Detail queries read detail.messages up to the snapshot's newest id.

messages.body: Kickoff: auth moves to the new token API today. Claim before you edit.

Is the 401 body part of the contract, or can it change?
Plain text for now. A test will pin it once the spec says otherwise, and the handler returns the same body for every 401.
Next: the token endpoint in src/auth/token.py once the spec lands. I will review the diff.
